# Empire Medical Training

> > Empire Medical Training delivers AMA PRA Category 1 CME-accredited hands-on certification courses in aesthetic medicine, functional medicine, and medspa business for MDs, nurses, dentists, and healthcare professionals.

Empire Medical Training is a leading provider of continuing medical education in aesthetic procedures, offering 30+ hands-on certification courses in injectables, lasers, and body contouring, along with comprehensive business training for launching profitable medspa practices. Located in Los Angeles, CA, the academy serves physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and dentists seeking advanced clinical and business credentials.

## Key Topics

- CME Accreditation (AMA PRA Category 1 Credit)
- Botox Certification
- Dermal Filler Training
- Aesthetic Injections
- Hands-on Workshop
- Continuing Education
- Medical Professionals
- Aesthetic Medicine
- PDO Threads
- Medspa Business
- Functional Medicine
- Injectable Techniques
- Aesthetic Procedures
- Empire Clinical Fellowship
- Physician Training

## Aesthetic Injection Certification

- [Botox Certification—Hands-On Aesthetic Injection Training](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/aesthetic-workshops/complete-botox-training): Level 1 Botox & Dermal Filler hands-on certification course with comprehensive injection training.
- [Dermal Filler Training Courses - Hands-on Training](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/aesthetic-workshops/complete-dermal-filler-training): Hands-on dermal filler certification covering Juvederm, Restylane, Radiesse, and Sculptra.
- [Advanced Botulinum Toxin-A / Dermal Filler Training (Level II)](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/aesthetic-workshops/advanced-botulinum-toxin-and-filler-training): Advanced Level II course in botulinum toxin and dermal filler injection techniques for healthcare professionals.
- [Advanced Lip Filler Techniques](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/aesthetic-workshops/advanced-lip-filler-techniques): Advanced lip augmentation training covering Russian technique and specialized filler methods.
- [Advanced Facial Anatomy Cadaver Workshop](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/aesthetic-workshops/anatomical-based-aesthetics-training): 8 CME credit cadaver dissection workshop for safe injectable aesthetics with plastic surgeons.

## Clinical Fellowship & Comprehensive Training

- [Botox & Filler Training for Doctors, NPs & PAs | Empire Clinical Fellowship™](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/aesthetic-workshops/fast-track): CME-accredited Empire Clinical Fellowship with hands-on training, real patients, and 90-day mentorship.
- [Aesthetic Training Courses Hub](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/aesthetic-workshops): Main aesthetic training hub with 30+ CME-accredited courses in injectables and laser procedures.
- [The Winning Consultation](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/aesthetic-workshops/winning-consultation): Training on patient consultation techniques and conversion strategies for aesthetic practices.

## Specialized Aesthetic Procedures

- [Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) Training](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/aesthetic-workshops/platelet-rich-plasma-training): Hands-on PRP certification for medical and aesthetic applications with latest protocols.
- [Sclerotherapy Training Courses and Workshops](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/aesthetic-workshops/sclerotherapy-training): Hands-on sclerotherapy certification for vein treatment using latest injection techniques.
- [Cosmetic Laser Training and Courses](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/aesthetic-workshops/complete-cosmetic-laser-training): 2-day hands-on cosmetic laser certification covering hair removal, IPL, YAG techniques.
- [Facial Aesthetic Certification Course](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/aesthetic-workshops/complete-facial-aesthetic-training): Facial aesthetic certification including chemical peels, microdermabrasion, and microneedling.
- [PDO Thread Training (Level I)](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/aesthetic-workshops/pdo-threads-training-level-I): Level I PDO threads certification for thread-lifting aesthetic procedures and patient selection.
- [Kybella® & Mesotherapy Training for Face & Body Contouring](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/aesthetic-workshops/kybella-mesotherapy-training-for-face-and-body-contouring): Hands-on Kybella and mesotherapy certification for non-surgical fat reduction and body contouring.

## Business & Practice Development

- [Med Spa Business Training & Medical Spa Marketing Courses](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/business-marketing-workshops): Business training hub covering medspa startup, business planning, and marketing strategies.
- [Medspa Business and Marketing Masterclass](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/blueprint-for-success): Intensive medspa business and marketing masterclass for launching profitable aesthetic practices.

## Medical & Functional Medicine Training

- [Functional Medicine Training](https://www.empiremedicaltraining.com/medical-workshops/anti-aging-training): Functional medicine and anti-aging certification covering hormone replacement and pellet therapies.
